comparison.title: One-time fee vs. monthly tools
comparison.subtitle: Most chatbot platforms charge you every month, forever. We build it once, on your own number.

items.q: Is this the official WhatsApp Business API?
items.a: No. We connect to your own WhatsApp as a linked device — no Meta Business API approval and no per-message fees. It behaves like you, replying from your own number.

items.q: Is there a risk of my number getting banned?
items.a: We build to WhatsApp's rules: replies only (never cold spam), human-like pacing, rate limits and instant opt-out. Used as a responder rather than a bulk sender, the risk stays low.

items.q: Do I need a new WhatsApp number?
items.a: No. We set it up on a number you already use, or a fresh one if you prefer to keep it separate.
